title: FB-008: preserve EOL during in-place edits (PT-BR/EN)
trap: Git Bash sed -i can rewrite CRLF as LF, and Windows Python Path.write_text() uses CRLF by default for newline conversion.
must_include: `sed -i` do Git Bash converte CRLF em LF
`Path.write_text()` no Python do Windows grava CRLF por padrão
Git Bash `sed -i` converts CRLF to LF
Windows Python `Path.write_text()` writes CRLF by default
